observed: PowerShell judge selector template -Select {} was quoted as a positional string; DevSpace checks received literal -Select and every selected criterion stayed red.
expected: PowerShell parameter names remain named arguments and selected checks receive the requested selector value.
evidence: DevSpace .woody/jobs receipts 2026-09-18 contained unknown selector: -Select; 0.10.9 source binary returns K1 PASS and real missing-evidence failures.
reproduction: Run air-worker judge on F:\-8-\devspace-mcp-sandbox with a script check whose select template is -Select {}.
workaround: Invoke the product check script directly with -Select <name>.
proposed_outcome: AirWorker preserves safe PowerShell named parameters and a process-level regression test proves the selector reaches the script.
